probe: The two items era 98's build left unmeasured

notice_relay.question: In an ordinary session, does the model pass the SessionStart cleanup notice on to the user?
notice_relay.method: Two headless sessions at the repository root, Claude Code with claude-sonnet-5, an ordinary two-sentence question about the gate directory. Six cleanup candidates were ready.
notice_relay.verdict: The hook fires every time; the model relays the notice in 1 of 2 sessions. The model channel alone does not reliably reach the user. Whether the interactive UI shows systemMessage is still unmeasured.

canary_after_change.question: Does the changed corpus canary keep the full report local and commit only a redacted copy?
canary_after_change.method: python3 -m corpus canary --mislabel (one session), corpus home and work directory under the local root, --report to a scratch path

observed.note: exit 1 and rejected are the expected outcome of the mislabel run
observed.full_report: written to the work directory, session_id kept
